content:
Welcome to Neural Brew.

What can I make for you today?  
Please tell me:

1) Drink: espresso / americano / cappuccino / latte / flat white / mocha / drip  
2) Size: small / medium / large  
3) Caffeine: regular / decaf / half-caf  
4) Milk (if any): whole / skim / oat / almond / soy / none  
5) Sweetness: none / 1 / 2 / 3 sugars (or syrup: vanilla/caramel/hazelnut)  
6) Any extras: extra shot, hot/iced, extra hot, foam level, cinnamon, etc.
